search.query: | inputlookup gn_scan_deployment_ip_lookup where (_key=$tkn_ip_address$) | search noise=$tkn_scanner$ AND $tkn_bizserv$ | eval noise = if(noise=="1", "True", if(noise=="0", "False", "NA")) | eval RIOT = if(RIOT=="1", "True", if(RIOT=="0", "False", "")) | rename _key as IP, noise as "Internet Scanner", RIOT as "Business Service", last_checked as "Last Checked", classification as Classification, trust_level as "Trust Level" | eval "Check Live Status" = "Check Live Status" | table IP, "Internet Scanner", "Business Service", Classification, "Trust Level", "Last Checked", "Check Live Status" | sort -last_checked

single.title: Current Internet Scanner status of IP: $tkn_ip_for_request$

search.query: | gnquick ip="$tkn_ip_for_request$" | spath output=noise path=results.internet_scanner_intelligence.found | spath output=RIOT path=results.business_service_intelligence.found | spath output=classification path=results.internet_scanner_intelligence.classification | spath output=trust_level path=results.business_service_intelligence.trust_level | eval last_checked=strftime(time(), "%Y-%m-%d %T") | eval _key = ip | outputlookup gn_scan_deployment_ip_lookup key_field=_key | eval "Internet Scanner" = if(noise="true", noise . " / " . classification, if(noise="false", "False", "Could not retrieve noise status")) | table "Internet Scanner"

single.title: Current Business Services status of IP: $tkn_ip_for_request$

search.query: | gnquick ip="$tkn_ip_for_request$" | spath output=noise path=results.internet_scanner_intelligence.found | spath output=RIOT path=results.business_service_intelligence.found | spath output=classification path=results.internet_scanner_intelligence.classification | spath output=trust_level path=results.business_service_intelligence.trust_level | eval last_checked=strftime(time(), "%Y-%m-%d %T") | eval _key = ip | outputlookup gn_scan_deployment_ip_lookup key_field=_key | eval trust_level = if(trust_level=1, "Reasonably Ignore", if(trust_level=2, "Commonly Seen", "Unknown")) | eval "Business Service" = if(RIOT="true", RIOT . " / " . trust_level, if(RIOT="false", "False", "Could not retrieve noise status")) | table "Business Service"
